text:
amy: FYI p99 spike in dedicated-usw1 around 06:10 for small prompt traffic. looks like TOR egress queueing + allocator churn. anyone seeing similar?
jared: yep, r14/r15 showing tor_tx_qdepth rising. quick snippets: 
```
2026-07-21T06:09:58Z tor-agent[14]: tx_qdepth iface=tor-eth0 depth=78->126
2026-07-21T06:10:01Z shard-proxy: egress_bytes tenant=org-12 delta=92MB/s burst=true
2026-07-21T06:10:03Z allocator: prefill_start tenant=org-99 parallel=3 crossrack=true
```
amy: org-12 is a backup job, org-99 is a newly promoted fractional tenant that started aggressive warms. combo is saturating TOR and causing slab splits.
nina: ops flagged an unexpected egress charge for org-12. short-term mitigation?
oncall-sre: i'm oncall. propose: 1) apply per-tenant egress leash 40MB/s on pool-proxy, 2) set promo-quarantine for org-99 (no cross-rack warms) for 30m, 3) set prefill_concurrency_limit=1. ops runbook commands below.
ops-automation: commands: 
```bash
rctl config set prod pool-proxy egress_leash_per_tenant=true
rctl config set prod pool-proxy egress_leash_bytes_per_sec=41943040
rctl config set prod allocator prefill_concurrency_limit=1
rctl tenant update org-99 --promo-quarantine=true --note="temp-isolation"
```
jared: applied the config changes. infra-bot: recorded config set by oncall-sre at 2026-07-21T06:12:10Z
amy: watching metrics  p99 dropped from 420ms to ~140ms in ~70s. org-99 egress fell to ~7MB/s. org-12 backup remains high but less bursty.
nina: follow-ups: 1) add scheduler headroom probe before cross-rack warms (cheap TCP/UDP probe to TOR), 2) add promo flow safety check to require "allow_crossrack_prefill" flag on fractional promotions, default false, 3) add alert for sustained per-tenant egress > 60MB/s over 5m.
oncall-sre: agree. also request automated promo rollback if the promotion causes per-tenant egress alert within 10m.
ajared: i'll file the scheduler PR and a promo-flow change. nina: can you own alerts and billing reconciliation?
nina: on it, filing tickets now and will coordinate with billing. closing loop unless it flares back. :thumbsup:
